plants.title: Learning from life.
plants.description: Sun, veined leaves, a bee, flowers, fruit and a droplet: a journey from light to the essence of plants.
plants.caption: Look at a leaf, recognise an aroma, bring a discovery into the kitchen.

underground.title: Knowing means connecting.
underground.description: A shoot, mushrooms and a cross-section of soil reveal branching roots and a fine network of mycelium. An image of the connections and time that sustain growth.
underground.caption: Beneath what we see lie time and relationships. Learning also means listening and sharing.
